codeReview.summary: The spatial rebuild feature was implemented correctly across all core requirements. The diff shows changes to workspace-canvas.tsx (territory centering, committed zoom at 0.85, neighbor opacity spread to 0.5, dots background stabilization), auto-layout.ts (exported RADIAL_DISTANCE, WORKSTREAM_TERRITORY, WORKSTREAM_MIN_DISTANCE constants), and workspace-store.ts (per-workstream viewMode persistence via viewModeByWorkstream map). Automated tests pass (12 targeted tests, 409 total). The implementation correctly addresses scroll→zoom (panOnScroll=false, zoomOnScroll=true), territory constants (1500x1200px), semantic zoom with 180ms debounce, blank background mode, position persistence with local overrides, and per-workstream viewMode. One non-blocking observation: the feature description mentions completed workspaces repositioned by 'mean density' but the actual implementation uses fixed RADIAL_DISTANCE.completed (5000) without density computation; this is consistent with the radial band approach and covered by the existing test.

summary: Feature w1-c1-spatial-rebuild passes review. The implementation correctly addresses all listed requirements: large territories (1500x1200px), correct zoom bands (overview <0.20, summary 0.20-0.55, detail >=0.55), scroll→zoom behavior (panOnScroll=false, zoomOnScroll=true), stabilized dots/blank background, exported radial distance constants, semantic zoom with 180ms debounce, position persistence with local overrides, per-workstream viewMode persistence, and committed zoom at 0.85 (landscape/detail transition). Timer functionality (FocusTimerNode, timerState) was correctly preserved since the feature is about removing 'timer toggles' from the canvas UI, not the timer subsystem itself. All automated tests pass. The only gap is that completed workspaces use fixed radial distance rather than mean-density computation, but this is a minor simplification that maintains correctness of the radial band placement.
